issues.description: The problem statement text instructs that messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) should accept a double parameter (to report milk volume), but the UML, the template usage in Main.java, and the provided solution define messageOnMilk() without any parameter. This contradiction leaves students unsure whether to implement a parameterized method or a parameterless one and would cause signature mismatches with the provided template Main and the expected solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the signature mismatch: either (A) update the problem statement to require messageOnMilk() without parameters (aligning text with the UML, template Main usage, and solution), or (B) change the template and solution to use messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) everywhere (update Milkable, implementations, and calls in Main and Farm) and adjust printed return strings accordingly. Ensure the UML, example code, and textual description consistently use the same method signature.

Either change the textual requirement to specify messageOnMilk() with no parameters, or update the UML, template, and solution to require messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and adjust all implementations and calls accordingly so a single consistent signature is used across the exercise.
